description: Continuous cellular automaton sequencer: 32 starting values are run through a rule 32 times, and the picture that makes is read by up to sixteen play heads

params.text: The number the rule works with, 0 to 1; every change recalculates the whole picture
Moves the play head across the generations
Moves the play head across the cells
Multiplies the cell value, which runs from 0 to 1, before it reaches the output, 0 to 10
Picks the rule applied to the average of each cell and its two neighbours, one of five arithmetic functions of that average and the Param knob; its first two positions are swapped against the panel
The cell value a gate needs to reach, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Sets the first sixteen starting values, one channel per value, 0-10V read as 0 to 1
Sets the last sixteen starting values, one channel per value, 0-10V read as 0 to 1
Places a play head on a generation for each of its channels, the 32 generations spread over 0-10V, added to the CvX knob and wrapped around
Places a play head on a cell for each of its channels, the 32 cells spread over 0-10V, added to the CvY knob and wrapped around
Adds to the scale, one channel per play head, one for one in volts
Adds to the offset, one channel per play head, one for one in volts
Selects the rule, 0-10V across the five, and overrides the Func knob while patched
Sets that number, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the Param knob while patched

outputs.text: The cell value under the play head, multiplied by the scale and shifted by the offset, one channel per play head
Carries 10V on a play head's channel while the cell under it is at or above the threshold

notes: the 32 starting values can only be set from the 0-15 and 16-31 inputs; with neither of them patched every starting value stays at zero
menu: Color Mode — draws the picture in Grey, Palette 1, Palette 2 or Palette 3
